note: Guards are hard: a candidate failing any of them has no score. Positive paired deltas are candidate minus baseline. v2, user decision 18 Sep 2026: behaviour is judged on generated town maps only. The objective ranks on town-val; generated trench maps are kept only to prove soldiers still shoot (zero_shot, firing_squads); the static authored maps and the F1 family leave the score and remain only in the external parity spot check. v1 is preserved as guards-v1.json. Town battles are still symmetric (both sides run the same controller), so the v2 objective carries no controller-quality signal until a head-to-head battle exists; it is recorded, not yet fit to optimise.
